text:
deploybot: Rollout v2.15.0 slot 27 paused and quarantined due to regional 503 surge in eu-control-plane. Quarantine time 14:12 UTC.
eva: ack. what's the immediate customer impact?
sam: seeing ~6% 5xx for inference-api in eu, primarily during token fetch. looks correlated with token-svc retries.
ops-oncall: investigating. token-svc burst from a config rollover; ongoing mitigation. ETA ~25m.
release-manager: do not auto-rollback. pin the release so we don't get a half-rollout. schedule reschedule if ops confirms external cause.
deploy-admin: pinned v2.15.0 on slot 27: `deployctl pin --service inference-api --version v2.15.0 --slot 27 --reason "INC-8501 token-svc"` Tagging ticket INC-8501.
deploybot: Pin recorded. Subsequent slots paused; slot 27 quarantined. Canary traffic drained to last-known-good.
ops-oncall: mitigation in progress: rolling back token-proxy config and increasing pool. monitoring metrics.
eva: prep rollback steps and hotfix branch in case it's app-related.
sam: rollback command (dry-run ready):
```
# rollback to v2.14.x
deployctl rollback --service inference-api --from-version v2.15.0 --to-version v2.14.12 --reason "INC-8501"
```
incident-bot: INC-8501 updated: token-proxy config rollback applied; error rate declining. next update in 10m.
release-manager: plan: keep pin, reschedule remaining slots to 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z, run a 5% pre-window canary at 01:30 UTC. leave slot 27 quarantined until post-canary verification. I'll update customer comms and the release doc.
deploy-admin: reschedule set and annotated in deploy ticket. owners assigned: @eva for pre-canary checks, @sam for rollback readiness.
release-manager: thanks all. we will reconvene if error rate rises. add postmortem note in release doc after canary. :white_check_mark:
